# Project Maya — Technical Summary

## What it is
Project Maya is a free, open-source local inference engine (MIT) for large MoE models on consumer PCs, serving GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash via a browser chat, OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs, and a one-command setup (`./setup.sh`).

## Models & quants
